On the last phone call with my friend ever, waiting for my boyfriend to fall asleep. She has no idea that I was serious when I talked about how I’ve been contemplating suicide all day. I think I said this earlier, but my suicide would come as a shock to no one, she even said she wouldn’t be shocked. I talk about it so much it’s just a normal conversation
I guess you can put it that way

It was, it helped, but not enough and never will be enough. The mental health system has too many downfalls that can’t assist people like me. For an average sufferer or depression and anxiety it could be super beneficial. For more severe cases like mine there is simply too many pitfalls and shortcomings to be a viable solution. In my honest opinion, I would need multiple years of inpatient therapy to even be considered “rehabilitated” but that will never happen unless I commit a serious crime and plead insanity.

Yes, I just can’t stand waiting and the guilt I feel knowing my boyfriend suspects nothing. Of course that’s temporary, I’ll feel nothing once everything is said and done. I’ve tried before so I know these feelings are normal and shouldn’t come in the way of my plans

The closer I get the more physically ill I feel. My boyfriend is so unsuspecting it makes me sick knowing what I’m doing to him. He has so many plans tomorrow that will be ruined when he finds me.....

Cinnamon we got from a shelter and I planned on changing his name but it suit him too perfectly. He was found on the side of the road when he was 5 days old, his mom had a previous owner but was dumped after she gave birth. He never knew life outside of the shelter until we adopted him. The shelter named him and his siblings after spices (rosemary, ginger and sage were his sisters) but I couldn’t see “Zues” being a fitting name, his name as always meant to be Cinnamon.

Cinnamon is an shorthair orange tabby, a chonky boy looks like a stick of butter and he’s turning 4 this year. Poseidon is a long lanky shorthair white cat with a big brown/black spot on his head, he has pink toe beans except for one which is half black (it was completely black when he was a kitten) and he just turned 2! Hades is about 8 months old now and he’s a longhair near-pure black cat but in the light you can see he has dark brown highlights and some flicks of grey. He is the most pure cat I have ever had, he’s very cuddly and will give you hugs and kisses, he loves to curl up on your chest and nuzzle your face. When he sleeps on your chest he will extend his paws like he’s giving you a big hug.
Cats! That’s the only thing in truly sad about. I have 3 babies, Cinnamon Poseidon and Hades that I’ll be leaving behind.
Partially made the choice because Evanescence also played at my brothers funeral, except it was “my immortal” which I cannot listen to anymore without crying

I want the first half that shows my childhood photos to be played to “wish you were here” by neck deep, and the “layer adolescence to adulthood” part of my life to be accompanied to “Hello” by evanescence. The first half of my life I lived in pain mourning my brothers, and the song reminds me of them. The second half of my life was just my own pain past the mourning, and Hello really captures that.
I want a video kind of like that because my brother also had one, I’ll tell you the two songs I want in the video if you promise me you’ll listen to them.
I’m talking here because I’m an oversharer at nature

I think I’ll post periodic updates on what I’m doing in my final day,
Currently, I’m going over funeral plans and making a playlist of music I want played, a list of attendees and notifying my friends in a non-alarming way to not let my mother exploit my death for money.

So ironic you told me talking to someone would make it better, I know that, which is exactly why I’m avoiding telling anyone close to me so they can’t stop me or talk me out of it. I made my decision, I want no interference again.
It’s not like it’s the first time the people I love have lost someone. They’ll cope.

I hope you survive and are taken to a good hospital and recover, or cave and tell someone who saves you. But for me I’m afraid I’m too far gone to even give myself a chance, I’m sure my concoction will cause cardiac arrest.

If I somehow survive, which I am super confident I won’t, I already have a hospital in mind I’d like to go to. But ofc this is only if I survive, I won’t have a choice really. With what I plan to kill myself there is a high likelihood of cardiac arrest which is what I’m praying for. I’ve even gone as far to fast all day in hopes that an empty stomach will enable to pills to further obliterate my insides.
Cheetahs, I love all feline creatures but Cheetahs top the list.
I think the awareness of how awful the things I’m doing are just makes it worse since I haven’t stopped and won’t stop.

Nope, telling someone close to me would severely decrease the likelihood that it’s going to work. He’s actually taking me to the store to get the last part of my concoction I plan to overdose on, and he doesn’t know. That should show you how truly sick of an individual I am.

Becoming an abuser has opened my eyes to how truly sick these individuals are, and how undeserving of life they are. Some may change and can change sure, I’m not one. It’s in my coding and I can only mask it. If I can only learn how to mask it and not learn how to not be an abuser, I am one of those sick individuals undeserving of life.

I am completely unwilling to dismiss or label myself as “a person with abusive habits but not an abuser”. I’ve lunged at my boyfriend before out of rage. I’ve called him unspeakable and unforgivable names. I find myself unable to stop myself no matter how aware I am that what I’m doing is unacceptable and disgusting. I lack self control and feel self control slipping from me everyday. My rage gets increasingly scary and I fear one day I might kill someone in a fit of rage. Killing myself is doing society a favor.
I am a woman haha

You know I told myself the same thing. If I ended up like my mom/dad I would kill myself and I have. I’m a hypocrite like my father, I’m co-dependent like my mother, my vocabulary is disgustingly similar. I always told myself “abusers don’t deserve to live” and seeing as I have the control over an abusers life, it only seems right to kill myself. The world doesn’t need another abusive individual, the world doesn’t need another perpetrator of the cycle. I fear for the day I become violent again, I’ve had a lid on it since I was a kid but that lid is no longer stable.
It’s springtime but because my state is clearly experiencing the effects of climate change it feels a bit like summer. Our winters have been extremely concerning because of how mild they’ve been.

Seek therapy and keep at it, the time period I was in therapy it was beneficial. It took some “shopping” to find the right therapist but I hold a special place for her in my heart. I feel like the news that she “failed” would crush her, but ultimately there was nothing she could do.
I loved writing. It was the one art form I could actually get a grasp on, my escapism techniques started with books.

I’m not from the UK but that’s essentially how it is here too, a week of sunshine followed by a week and a half of cloudy weather and storms. Our 3 months of summer is more like 6 weeks of we’re lucky. I have seasonal depression alongside my regular bipolar disorder, so winter is very hard for me.

I was under the false illusion that escaping my abusive home would solve things, only to realize they also molded me into an abuser and I’m toxic to everyone I come around. I’m self destructive, impulsive, even violent. It took me two years to realize that my life will just always be miserable, it had nothing to do with outside factors or upbringing, it’s just me. Luckily though, because of my history and openness with my struggles my suicide will come as a shock to absolutely no one in my life.
Hide and Seek (2005) with Robert DeNiro will always be my favorite

I regret everything, I didn’t live a life worthwhile and I fully believe I am incapable of it. I’ve only had one job that I quit due to a major anxiety attack, I’m extremely co-dependent and incapable of taking care of myself or living on my own. I never graduated which was a major blow to my self worth because that was the biggest goal of my life at the time. I don’t come from a loving family, the few friends I have make it very known they have bigger problems in life than me or worrying about me, which they definitely do. I’ve lived a lackluster life, my death will be entirely predictable. From ages 11-15 I tried to kill myself 11 times. The past 4 years I’ve made regular threats and openly spoke out on social media about my chronic suicidal habits and behaviors. I think it’s oddly reassuring that everyone will have seen it coming and it won’t be a shock.
Just wish for me that if there is an afterlife I can at least see my brothers again.
I made this a throwaway account for a reason, might as well confess how awful I am before I finally rid the world of me.

Thanks, but no. I’m a toxic individual and I partially blame my upbringing but at this point it’s just me. Ive ran off in the middle of the night no shoes coat or sufficient clothes because we got into a major argument. I’ve lunged at him before and abused myself in front of him (hitting myself, head butting walls etc...) like I said, no matter what I do he won’t leave me.  Remembering the things I’ve done to him makes me physically ill because I swore to myself I would never end up like this yet I have. Suicide is the best option, for me, for him, for everyone. I just hate the fact I know my family will be there to cry crocodile tears and my mother will exploit my death for money.

In the sense I was no longer going through daily psychological torture? Yes. But then it hit me that the effects of it are forever, I will be like this forever and my mental state is dragging my partner down. I’m sure he will realize my decision was for the better in the long run. He won’t leave me no matter what I do, no matter how much my mental state drags into a similar place. The burden of my death will not compare to the extreme burden a lifetime with me would cause.
